Description:
Apollo 21 is one of the largest suppliers of light and heavy duty commercial spare parts in Southern Africa and was founded in 1972. With over 50 years of experience the dedicated and experienced team at Apollo 21 specializes in procuring and distributing an extensive range of genuine quality Truck, Bus, Trailer and Transporter replacement parts. With our roots in the transport industry we have a precise understanding of what keeps your wheels turning.
We pride ourselves in offering our clients a complete trucking solution, providing you with a true one-stop shopping experience. Our main focus is in providing genuine quality, branded products at cost effective prices and efficient service to keep you moving.
From bumper to bumper we’ve got you covered.
